author: BTKing
body:
Hello. Hi.

Most of you probably have no idea who I am, nor I know who you are. I used to play on the Overcast Network, but when that shut down, I've been wandering from server to server trying to find some server I can call home. As this server is similar in game play to Overcast, I really enjoy playing on it. I feel like a stranger to the community, so I've decided (and because Crazy told me to) to make this post, including a AMA. So ask away, I'll try to answer all questions.

replies.body:
Thanks!
What do you Think of the maps on Avicus?
I like them, although I haven't played enough maps to name any my favourites. 
Do you plan on joining any team?
Ideally, that's something that would interest me, but I'd rather familiarize myself with the community first before joining any team.
Favourite colour?
I don't really have one
Favourite food?
Green apples of course
Favourite subject in school?
Mathematics (I'm probably with the minority on that one)
